implementation.early_rejection: Public calls check connection type/rights and endpoint queue before count admission/allocation, then recheck before mutation.
implementation.scope: Exact-root, original call/reply count admission before fallible pending-node allocation outside IPC; prepared node publication and complete post-IPC rollback/disposal.
implementation.preparation: Capture namespace under IPC; leave IPC for caller operation lease; revalidate namespace and reserve call/reply counts atomically under IPC; leave IPC for node allocation and bind its original call charge. Revalidate before authority admission.
implementation.owner: PreparedCall retains caller lease, captured namespace, original counts, partial node, authority, pending waiter metadata, delegated connection, currently attaching transfer and memory/loan vectors. Ordinary work finishes post-IPC, root last. ManuallyDrop fallback retains every field.
implementation.publication: Pending-map insertion only relinks prepared storage after shared authority publication. One publication attempt per owner; no retry entry point.
implementation.disposal: Serialized call close and PreparedCancellation detach the complete pending node and leave IPC before releasing payload/node/charge. Shared node machinery destroys storage before original charge refund. Failed loans retain live node/fences.
implementation.generation_control: Close now rejects while an unpublished call retains its exact-root lease. Explicit finish precedes teardown and exact ASID/capability-number reuse; successor behavior is checked independently. No lease is released to manufacture stale live preparation.

controls.copied_fixture_backing: One original source and its unpublished private copy; original root/account ownership retained.
